title: Endur (xSTRK / xyBTCs) Starknet LST — no unprivileged extraction available
closed_reasons: ERC-4626 deposit->redeem round-trip is provably non-profitable: deposit floors shares, redeem floors assets, so out <= in for every size; measured max profit 0 wei over 11 sizes and withdraw->redeem net 0 wei (live preview + exact integer math)

withdrawal-queue request_withdrawal(assets,shares,receiver) is caller-gated ('Only LST can call') so an attacker cannot inject a mismatched assets/shares pair (the queue trusts the LST's assets and does not re-derive it)

WQ.claim_withdrawal(id) is permissionless but pays the recorded assets to the ERC-721 owner (verified by trace); claim_withdrawal_to is owner-gated; isClaimed prevents double-claim; STRK is a plain ERC-20 (no reentrancy)
WQ.take_funds and VR.receive_funds are permissionless but self-funded (transferFrom(msg.sender,...)) -> they are donations, never a drain; the VR's unlimited allowance to the WQ is not reachable
every admin/rate/registry/upgrade entry point is role-gated ('Caller does not have role' / 'Only LST can call' / 'Invalid caller'); all six vaults are unpaused and solvent
no first-depositor/donation inflation: all vaults have total_supply > 0 and total_assets is derived from the ValidatorRegistry's staked principal + cash, not from the vault's own token balance
key_facts: TVL across the 6 ERC-4626 vaults at block 16815577 = $11,786,829.64 (xSTRK $7.86M, xWBTC $2.14M, strkBTC $1.30M, xtBTC $0.27M, xsBTC $0.14M, xLBTC $0.08M)

all 6 vaults share implementation class 0x5f06dcb8ef65dd934ba261e6f5ddc03ad3707a028236289feef4ef451f01a52; WQ class 0x6b2e18936382d3f686472418a81ccac0a996a6261afe7416bc905be12903f34; VR class 0x432c02039833e1d0a937e8fbd472181579fbe068a2434dfea0420b3dd800502
LST.total_assets(STRK) == VR.total_stake(STRK) == sum(validators staked_amount) + VR STRK balance (delta 0 at the pinned block); it excludes accrued-but-unclaimed staking rewards
xSTRK: total_assets 147,960,394.51 STRK, total_supply 124,531,370.82 xSTRK, rate 1.18813752; vault holds only 1 STRK idle (everything else staked)
xSTRK withdrawal queue: max_request_id 10689, unprocessed 0, intransit 2,083,577.27 STRK, cumulative_requested 126,183,544.50 STRK, claim_time 604800s (7 days), lstDisp = 0x28d7...4b0a
STRK allowance VR->WQ = 2^256-1 (used by take_funds), LST->WQ = 0; WQ STRK balance 474,516.90 STRK, VR STRK balance 13,423.29 STRK

targeted probes (caller=0): request_withdrawal -> 'Only LST can call'; reduce_total_queue_amount -> 'Invalid caller'; LST.send_to_withdraw_queue -> role; VR.send_to_withdrawal_queue -> 'Only LST can call'; take_funds/receive_funds -> 'ERC20: insufficient allowance' (self-funded); claim_withdrawal -> proceeds (permissionless, pays owner); VR.claim_rewards_for_validator -> 'Out of gas' (permissionless, token-gated)
method limitation: starknet_call forces caller_address=0x0, so gates were proven by reverts rather than impersonation; caller 0 is the least-privileged address
caveats: Endur's own 'lst' Cairo source is NOT public (only the deployed ABI, the Cairo Security Clan audit of Endur-fi/lst commit d607247e, and Endur's relayer TS ABIs); conclusions rest on ABI + on-chain traces + audit, not source review

latent (LOW, not counted in E-U): total_assets excludes unclaimed staking rewards, so a reward-timing arbitrage (deposit before a permissionless claim_rewards_for_validator, redeem after) exists; measured unclaimed rewards for one validator's 20 delegators ~1,269 STRK (~$67), system-wide order $10^2-$10^3, and not net-profitable via flash loans; redemption is also queued 7 days
role holders were not enumerated (would need role-grant events); admin surface exists but is not a value-extraction path
Starknet has no EVM fork, so the PoC is a read-only keyless probe (starknet_call/preview + exact integer math), not a Foundry fork test
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Endur's $11.79M Starknet LST: ERC-4626 rounding favours the vault, withdrawal-queue requests are gated to the LST, take_funds/receive_funds are self-funded donations, claims pay the NFT owner, and every admin/rate function is role-gated; residual risk is only a bounded (~$10^2-$10^3) reward-timing arbitrage because total_assets excludes unclaimed staking rewards.
